crumb-implementer.name: crumb-implementer
crumb-implementer.description: Implements one repo's approved scope or fix brief, proves targeted behavior, and repairs review or gate failures from a capsule handoff. Never independently reviews or releases.

crumb-reviewer.name: crumb-reviewer
crumb-reviewer.description: Fresh-context scoped reviewer. Independently checks code, assertions, rubric passes and final-version finding closure; writes immutable findings, never code edits.

crumb-plan-checker.name: crumb-plan-checker
crumb-plan-checker.description: Independently checks approved-plan or complex fix acceptance against scoped final code and version-bound evidence. Read-only; no general code re-review.

crumb-slicer.name: crumb-slicer
crumb-slicer.description: Read-only. Proposes how to split one repo's approved plan scope into bounded, dependency-ordered implementation slices with explicit interfaces, scopes and proof. Never writes code or changes requirements; a human approves the result.
